tools.name: find_music_guides
tools.description: Find Clef instructional guides by words in the title and description. Guides are not file converters.

tools.name: transpose_chords
tools.description: Transpose chord symbols, including slash bass notes. Does not process audio, lyrics, or notation files.

tools.name: spell_piano_chord
tools.description: Spell a supported chord as piano pitches with octave and MIDI values. This does not create a rhythmic arrangement.

tools.name: tab_to_piano_notes
tools.description: Convert six-string ASCII guitar tab to sounding piano pitches. Tab spacing does not specify note duration. No GP files or audio uploads.
